name: Gate & rules
author: Brett
description: The gate a PR must pass before it lands, and the auto-lander that lands it, in one place (gate-rules@1, framework/spec/GATE.md). Rules tab: every gate rule (CI green, tests, theme, controls, toolbars, UI Review, code clash, merge-queue policy) with its on/off switch, severity and settings, Reset to defaults and Check a PR. Auto-lander tab: one mode switch Merge queue on/off (on = PRs go through the stacked merge queue; off, the default = the auto-lander lands each finished build one at a time), status, waiting PRs with the rule that holds each one and why, last runs, Land now, Pause and Resume. History tab: every rule change and lander action (who, when, before/after). The same calls through REST (/api/plugins/gate), MCP (gate_* and lander_*), the CLI (axf gate …) and voice. Rules and history live in the plugin's data folder; the lander settings are mirrored into the merge-queue provider's config so one switch is the switch the lander obeys. Two adapters (gate-store.mjs, lander.mjs) are the only files a later axf-molly backend replaces.
